deals.deal: 50% Off an Original Sandwich or Wrap When You Buy a Bowl, Code BOWLS
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 22: order a bowl and an Original sandwich or wrap on potbelly.com or in the Potbelly app, enter code BOWLS at checkout, and the lower-priced of the two is half off. Once per order; online and app orders only; participating shops. The code and terms come from Potbelly's own promotion, but Potbelly does not show them on its public site, so if the code is refused at checkout the offer has been pulled.

deals.deal: Free Medium Classic Smoothie with Every $30 Gift Card Purchase
deals.desc: Buy a single $30 gift card, or combine cards that add up to $30, and get a coupon for one free medium Classic smoothie per $30 purchase (in-store only, not valid online).

deals.deal: Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bonus Card
deals.desc: Buy $50 or more in Panera gift cards in-cafe, in the app or online and receive a free $10 bonus card redeemable in January, no code needed.

deals.deal: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
deals.desc: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage.
deals.region: VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX

deals.deal: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 22: Moe Rewards members (free account) get one Grilled Burrito Dipper with the returning shredded-beef Birria free with any purchase, in the app, online or in the restaurant. Single use; the fine print says the offer goes to select members, so check the Rewards tab in the app before ordering. Not valid with dipper pans, other offers or third-party delivery; participating locations. Stated on moes.com.

deals.deal: $5 Off a $10+ Order with Code THANK5 in the Pancheros App
deals.desc: All November: enter code THANK5 in the Pancheros app (free account) for $5 off any order of $10 or more, which covers a burrito or bowl plus a side or drink. The homepage states no exclusions; one code per order. Stated on Pancheros' own homepage.

deals.deal: Free Dumplings, WaBeverage or Crepe Cake with $5 Purchase (WaBa Rewards)
deals.desc: Announced by email on 2026-11-16: WaBa Rewards members get a free item of choice (5 dumplings, a 16oz WaBeverage, or an anniversary crepe cake valued at $4.79) with any $5 purchase, valid through November 22, free account required.

deals.deal: Taco Tuesdaze: 2 Tacos + Chips + Drink for $7.99
deals.desc: Every Tuesday at participating locations: two tacos, chips, and a drink for $7.99 in-store, online, or in the app - no third-party delivery, and pricing varies slightly by location.

deals.deal: Sushi Tuesday: Select Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Tuesday, Dierbergs sells select varieties of its hand-rolled Bento sushi for $6 each (regularly $8 to $10). In store, no card or app needed, while supplies last.

deals.deal: Topping Tuesday: Free Premium Topping with Any Bowl
deals.desc: Every Tuesday, pick one premium topping (avocado, kimchi, masago, surimi and more, normally an upcharge) free with any poke bowl. Ask at the counter; no app, code or account needed.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: $6 Sushi Tuesday: Fresh Sushi Specials
deals.desc: Every Tuesday, Rouses Markets runs $6 fresh sushi specials at its in-store sushi counters across the Gulf Coast. Rouses does not list which rolls are included or the regular price, so check the case. Stated on Rouses' own prepared foods page.

deals.deal: Taco Tuesday: Buy Two Tacos, Get the Third Free
deals.desc: Every Tuesday, dine-in or take-out when you order at the counter: buy two tacos and the third is free. It does not work for online or delivery orders. No code or account needed. Surfside has restaurants in McLean, the Wharf, Dupont and Tenleytown; its specials page has not been updated recently, so confirm at the register before ordering. Stated on Surfside's own weekly specials page.

deals.deal: Taco Tuesday: $2.75 Tacos
deals.desc: Every Tuesday: the day's featured tacos are $2.75 each, down from the usual $4.00 to $4.75. The tacos on special change, so check the Tuesday item on your store's ordering page or call ahead. No code or account needed. Bandit Taco has shops on U Street and in Tenleytown, Leesburg and College Park. Stated on Bandit Taco's own specials page.
deals.region: DC, Leesburg VA & College Park MD

deals.deal: Taco Tuesday: Buy Three Specialty Tacos, Get a Classic Taco Free, Dine-In
deals.desc: Every Tuesday, dine-in only: buy three specialty tacos and get one classic taco free. No code or account needed. Taco Rock has restaurants in Oakton, Falls Church, Rosslyn, Alexandria and Lorton. Stated on Taco Rock's own specials page.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free with Every Adult Entree, Dine-In
deals.desc: Every day, dine-in only: kids 12 and under get a free mini rice bowl with each adult entree (a Premium Bowl, Sandweech or Large Salad), up to two kids per adult entree. Children must be there when you order; not valid online or through delivery apps. A kids bowl is usually $6.49. Stated on Pita Way's own specials page.

deals.deal: Tuesday Special: Detroit Pita, a Side and a Drink for $9.99, Online Orders
deals.desc: Tuesdays only, when you order on Pita Way's own website or app: a Detroit Chicken Shawarma, Gyro Shawarma or Falafel pita, a side of hummus and pita chips or fries, and a drink for $9.99. The pita and side alone are usually $12.49. No code or account needed. Stated on Pita Way's own specials page.

deals.deal: Red Cup Day: Free Reusable Holiday Cup with Any Handcrafted Holiday Drink
deals.desc: Tuesday, November 17 only: order any size handcrafted holiday or fall beverage, hot, iced or blended, and get a free 16 oz reusable red cup, while supplies last. Works in the cafe, the drive-thru, the Starbucks app and Starbucks delivery; no account needed. Brewed Christmas Blend coffee does not count. Cups usually run out by midday, so go early. Stated on Starbucks' own Red Cup Day page.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free with the Purchase of an Adult Bowl
deals.desc: Every day at Roots Natural Kitchen: a child under 12 eats free with each adult grain or salad bowl purchased. The child has to be there with you; no code or account needed. Roots states no day or time limits, so confirm at the counter when you order. Shown on every page of Roots' own site, including the Fairfax, Virginia location page.

deals.deal: PERi Buffalo Meal Deal: Sandwich or 6 Wings with PERi Chips and a Drink for $11.99
deals.desc: Limited time: a PERi Buffalo Pulled Chicken Sandwich or six flame-grilled PERi Buffalo wings, plus PERi Chips and a fountain drink, for $11.99. deals.deal: Taco Tuesday: 2 Tacos, Chips and Dip and a Drink for $8 for Rewards Members
deals.desc: Every Tuesday: two tacos, regular chips and dip and a regular fountain drink for $8 for Freebirds Rewards members (free account), or $9.99 without an account. One per guest; limited-time proteins and extras cost more; while supplies last. Stated on Freebirds' own homepage.

deals.deal: Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Appetizers with Code BOGO, Online Orders
deals.desc: Limited time at Michigan locations: add two qualifying items from the same category on the chain's own ordering site (for example a Chicken Great Greek Gyro, Feta-Filled Kebab Gyro or Falafel Pita, $10.99 to $12.99 each) and enter promo code BOGO at checkout to get one free. One BOGO per order; categories cannot be mixed; no account needed. Seen on the Byron Center, Ann Arbor, West Bloomfield, Troy and Allen Park ordering pages.

deals.deal: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
deals.desc: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go.

deals.deal: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
deals.desc: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off).

deals.deal: Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicken or Tofu Bowls with Two Add-Ons for $20
deals.desc: Limited time: two charbroiled chicken or tofu rice bowls plus two add-ons for $20 together, at participating locations, no account or code needed. Flame Broiler bowls are usually about $11 to $12 each before add-ons. Stated on Flame Broiler's own homepage.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant.

deals.deal: Taco Tuesday: $2.50 Fish or Chicken Tacos, $3 Steak or Especial Tacos
deals.desc: Every Tuesday: the Original Fish Taco or Classic Chicken Taco for $2.50 each, the Fish Taco Especial or Classic Steak Taco for $3, and a three-shrimp-taco trio for $10.99, in the restaurant or online. Open to everyone, no account needed; prices may vary at some locations. Listed on Rubio's own weekly deals page.

deals.deal: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
deals.desc: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers.

deals.deal: Vegan Tuesday: 25% Off All Vegan Sushi and Dishes, All Day
deals.desc: Every Tuesday, all day: 25% off every vegan (VG) item on the menu, including the vegan maki and nigiri. No code or account needed. Blue Sushi is a sit-down restaurant, so this is a dine-in special; ask about takeout at your location. Stated on Blue Sushi Sake Grill's own daily specials page.

deals.deal: Free Bowl or Pita at CAVA's Community Day in Windermere: Reserve a Free Ticket
deals.desc: Saturday, November 21 and Sunday, November 22: CAVA is giving one free bowl or pita per person at its new restaurant at 4757 The Grove Drive in Windermere, before it opens. You need a free ticket for a time slot (10:30 AM to 2 PM, 2 to 5 PM or 5 to 8 PM), reserved ahead on CAVA's own Eventbrite page, and each guest needs their own ticket. Tickets are limited: CAVA's Bethesda, Maryland day on November 23 is already sold out, so reserve now. CAVA invites a donation to a local food charity, but the meal is free.

deals.deal: 40th Anniversary: Fajitas at 1986 Prices, from $8.14, Today Only
deals.desc: Tuesday, November 17 only: Uncle Julio's is selling its fajitas at 1986 prices for its 40th anniversary. Vegetable fajitas are $8.14, chicken $9.25, shrimp $9.64 and steak $9.95, served with guacamole, sour cream, cheese, rice, charro beans, peppers and onions and flour tortillas. No code or account is mentioned; the chain's announcement gives the hours as 11 AM to 9 PM. The Northern Virginia restaurants are in Reston, Fairfax, Ashburn, Gainesville and Woodbridge. Stated on Uncle Julio's own anniversary page.
